```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

# Each of these includes the result of fitting all models to all iterations for a specific distribution
# Number of rows is 100 iterations * 2 models + 100 iterations * 43 grid search values = 4500 rows for mixture
# Then, concatenating 10 distributions is 45000 rows
# After taking the min w.r.t BIC, we should have 300 rows per distribution * 10 distributions = 3000 rows

# Get all CSV file paths from same directory
files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Helper to pull the number before "_point.csv"
get_mean_from_fname <- function(path) {
  as.numeric(sub("^.*_([-+]?[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+)_point\\.csv$", "\\1", basename(path)))
}

# Concatenate all files and add true mean
results_all <- map_dfr(files, ~ read.csv(.x) %>%
  mutate(true_mean = get_mean_from_fname(.x), filename = basename(.x)))

# Load all results and get mixture model with smallest BIC
# Here, we get point estimates from fitting all models to all distributions (100 iterations)
results_BIC <- results_all %>% 
  group_by(distribution, model, true_mean, iteration) %>%
  slice_min(BIC, with_ties = FALSE)

# # 1000 rows (because this time, we only get the best-fitting model)
# BIC_selected <- results_BIC %>%
#   group_by(distribution, true_mean, iteration) %>%
#   slice_min(BIC, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
#   ungroup() 

# analyzing bootstrap

# Get all CSV file paths from the "bootstrap" subdirectory
files <- list.files("bootstrap", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Concatenate all files and extract the true mean
boot_res <- map_dfr(files, ~ read.csv(.x) %>%
  mutate(
    filename = basename(.x),
    true_mean = as.numeric(str_extract(filename, "(?<=_)[-+]?[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+(?=_bootstrap\\.csv$)"))
  ))

# For each distribution, model, true_mean, iteration, and bootstrap iteration, take the result with the lowest BIC
# 5 distributions * 2 means * 3 models * 100 iterations * 500 bootstrap iters = 1500000 rows
boot_res <- boot_res %>%
  group_by(distribution, model, true_mean, iteration, bootstrap_iter) %>%
  slice_min(BIC, with_ties = FALSE)

# Define the columns you want bootstrap intervals for
cols <- c("w1", "NLL", "AIC", "BIC", "mean", "phi1", "phi2")

# 5 distributions * 2 means * 3 models * 100 iterations = 3000 rows
# Compute 2.5% and 97.5% quantiles for each column within each group
boot_percentiles <- boot_res %>%
  group_by(model, distribution, true_mean, iteration) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(cols),
                   list(lower = ~quantile(.x, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
                        upper = ~quantile(.x, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
            .groups = "drop")

boot_percentiles <- boot_percentiles %>%
  mutate(covers = (mean_lower <= true_mean & mean_upper >= true_mean))

combined <- left_join(results_BIC, boot_percentiles, by = c("model", "distribution", "iteration", "true_mean"))

BIC_selected <- combined %>%
  group_by(distribution, iteration, true_mean) %>%
  slice_min(BIC, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(model = "BIC-selected")

combined_augmented <- bind_rows(combined, BIC_selected)
```

```{r}
# explore bias & empirical standard deviation & coverage
summary_table_21 <- combined_augmented %>%
  filter(true_mean == 21) %>%
  group_by(distribution, model) %>%
  summarise(
    bias = mean(mean) - mean(true_mean),
    sd_est = sd(mean),
    coverage_rate = mean(covers),  
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    model = recode(model,
                   "null" = "Geom",
                   "sum" = "Geom2",
                   "mixture" = "Mixture"),
    distribution = recode(distribution,
                   "geom" = "Geom (mean: 21 bp)",
                   "geom2" = "Geom2 (mean: 21 bp)",
                   "geom3" = "Geom3 (mean: 21 bp)",
                   "mixture" = "Mixture (mean: 21 bp)",
                   "unif" = "Uniform (mean: 21 bp)") # Capitalize e.g., "geom" -> "Geom"
  )

colnames(summary_table_21) <- c("Distribution", "Assumed Distribution", "Bias", "SD", "Coverage")

summary_table_21 <- summary_table_21 %>%
  mutate(
    Bias = as.numeric(formatC(Bias, format = "f", digits = 1)),
    `SD` = as.numeric(formatC(`SD`, format = "f", digits = 1)),
    Coverage = as.numeric(formatC(Coverage, format = "f", digits = 2))
  )

# explore bias & empirical standard deviation & coverage
summary_table_100 <- combined_augmented %>%
  filter(true_mean == 100) %>%
  group_by(distribution, model) %>%
  summarise(
    bias = mean(mean) - mean(true_mean),
    sd_est = sd(mean),
    coverage_rate = mean(covers),  
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    model = recode(model,
                   "null" = "Geom",
                   "sum" = "Geom2",
                   "mixture" = "Mixture"),
    distribution = recode(distribution,
                   "geom" = "Geom (mean: 100 bp)",
                   "geom2" = "Geom2 (mean: 100 bp)",
                   "geom3" = "Geom3 (mean: 100 bp)",
                   "mixture" = "Mixture (mean: 100 bp)",
                   "unif" = "Uniform (mean: 100 bp)") # Capitalize e.g., "geom" -> "Geom"
  )

colnames(summary_table_100) <- c("Distribution", "Assumed Distribution", "Bias", "SD", "Coverage")

summary_table_100 <- summary_table_100 %>%
  mutate(
    Bias = as.numeric(formatC(Bias, format = "f", digits = 1)),
    `SD` = as.numeric(formatC(`SD`, format = "f", digits = 1)),
    Coverage = as.numeric(formatC(Coverage, format = "f", digits = 2))
  )

dist_order    <- c("geom" = "Geom (mean: 21 bp)", "geom" = "Geom (mean: 100 bp)",
                   "geom2" = "Geom2 (mean: 21 bp)", "geom2" = "Geom2 (mean: 100 bp)",
                   "geom3" = "Geom3 (mean: 21 bp)", "geom3" = "Geom3 (mean: 100 bp)",
                   "Uniform (mean: 21 bp)", "Uniform (mean: 100 bp)",
                   "Mixture (mean: 21 bp)", "Mixture (mean: 100 bp)")         

assumed_order <- c("Geom", "Geom2", "Mixture", "BIC-selected")

library(forcats)

summary_table <- rbind(summary_table_21, summary_table_100) %>%
  mutate(
    Distribution = fct_relevel(Distribution, dist_order),
    `Assumed Distribution` = fct_relevel(`Assumed Distribution`, assumed_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Distribution, `Assumed Distribution`)
```

```{r}
library(flextable)
library(officer)

# Create flextable and apply formatting
ft <- flextable(summary_table) %>%
  colformat_num(j = "Bias", digits = 1) %>%
  colformat_num(j = "SD", digits = 1) %>%
  colformat_num(j = "Coverage", digits = 2) %>%
  autofit()

# Save as Word doc and open it
doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(value = ft)

print(doc, target = "table_output.docx")
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)

results_BIC_21 <- results_BIC %>% filter(true_mean == 21)

# Step 1: Identify the set of all models and distributions
all_models <- unique(results_BIC_21$model)
all_distributions <- unique(results_BIC_21$distribution)

# Step 2: Get model with smallest BIC per (distribution, mean, iteration)
selected_models_21 <- results_BIC_21 %>%
  group_by(distribution, iteration) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = BIC, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 3: Count selections
model_selection_counts_21 <- selected_models_21 %>%
  count(distribution, model, name = "count")

# Step 4: Ensure all combinations are represented, fill in 0s
model_selection_counts_full_21 <- model_selection_counts_21 %>%
  complete(distribution = all_distributions, model = all_models, fill = list(count = 0))

model_selection_counts_formatted_21 <- model_selection_counts_full_21 %>%
  mutate(
    Distribution = recode(distribution,
                   "geom" = "Geom (mean: 21 bp)",
                   "geom2" = "Geom2 (mean: 21 bp)",
                   "geom3" = "Geom3 (mean: 21 bp)",
                   "mixture" = "Mixture (mean: 21 bp)",
                   "unif" = "Uniform (mean: 21 bp)"),
    `Setting of N` = case_when(
      model == "mixture" ~ "Mixture",
      model == "null" ~ "Geom",
      model == "sum" ~ "Geom2",
      TRUE ~ str_to_title(model)  # fallback for any others
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Distribution,
    `Setting of N`,
    `Times Selected by BIC` = count
  )

# View result
model_selection_counts_formatted_21
```

```{r}
### not used in paper but want to check bias of individual parameters in mixture
mixture_res <- combined_augmented %>% filter(model == "mixture", distribution == "mixture")
mixture_res$covers_w1 <- mixture_res$w1_upper > 0.05 & mixture_res$w1_lower < 0.05

mixture_res_100 <- mixture_res %>%
  filter(true_mean == 100) %>%
  group_by(distribution, model) %>%
  summarise(
    bias_w1 = mean(w1) - 0.05,
    bias_m1 = mean(1/phi1) - 700,
    bias_m2 = mean(1/phi2) - (100-700*0.05)/(1-0.05),
    
    sd_w1 = sd(w1),
    sd_m1 = sd(1/phi1),
    sd_m2 = sd(1/phi2),
    
    coverage_w1 = mean(mixture_res$w1_upper > 0.05 & mixture_res$w1_lower < 0.05),  
    coverage_m1 = mean(1/mixture_res$phi1_lower > 700 & 1/mixture_res$phi1_upper < 700),  
    coverage_m2 = mean(1/mixture_res$phi2_lower > (100-700*0.05)/(1-0.05) & mixture_res$phi2_upper < (100-700*0.05)/(1-0.05)),  
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    model = recode(model,
                   "null" = "Geom",
                   "sum" = "Geom2",
                   "mixture" = "Mixture"),
    distribution = str_to_title(distribution)  # Capitalize e.g., "geom" -> "Geom"
  )

mixture_res_21 <- mixture_res %>%
  filter(true_mean == 21) %>%
  group_by(distribution, model) %>%
  summarise(
    bias_w1 = mean(w1) - 0.005,
    bias_m1 = mean(1/phi1) - 725,
    bias_m2 = mean(1/phi2) - (21-725*0.005)/(1-0.005),
    
    sd_w1 = sd(w1),
    sd_m1 = sd(1/phi1),
    sd_m2 = sd(1/phi2),
    
    coverage_w1 = mean(mixture_res$w1_upper > 0.005 & mixture_res$w1_lower < 0.005),  
    coverage_m1 = mean(1/mixture_res$phi1_lower > 725 & 1/mixture_res$phi1_upper < 725),  
    coverage_m2 = mean(1/mixture_res$phi2_lower > (21-725*0.005)/(1-0.005) & mixture_res$phi2_upper < (21-725*0.005)/(1-0.005)),  
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    model = recode(model,
                   "null" = "Geom",
                   "sum" = "Geom2",
                   "mixture" = "Mixture"),
    distribution = str_to_title(distribution)  # Capitalize e.g., "geom" -> "Geom"
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
# Supplementary Figure

# Define PMF functions
calc_pmf_geom <- function(n, phi) {(1 - phi)^(n - 1) * phi}
calc_pmf_geom2 <- function(n, phi) {(n - 1) * (1 - phi)^(n - 2) * phi^2}
calc_pmf_geom3 <- function(n, phi) {choose(n - 1, 2) * (1 - phi)^(n - 3) * phi^3}

# Define support
x <- 1:2000

# Compute PMFs
pmf_geom     <- sapply(x, calc_pmf_geom, phi = 1 / 100)
pmf_geom2    <- sapply(x, calc_pmf_geom2, phi = 2 / 100)
pmf_geom3    <- sapply(x, calc_pmf_geom3, phi = 3 / 100)
pmf_uniform  <- ifelse(x >= 1 & x <= 199, 1 / 199, 0)

# Mixture parameters
weight1 <- 0.05
mean1 <- 700
mean2 <- (100 - weight1 * mean1) / (1 - weight1)  # = 1300 / 19
phi1 <- 1 / mean1
phi2 <- 1 / mean2

# Compute mixture using calc_pmf_geom
pmf_mix1 <- sapply(x, calc_pmf_geom, phi = phi1)
pmf_mix2 <- sapply(x, calc_pmf_geom, phi = phi2)
pmf_mixture <- weight1 * pmf_mix1 + (1 - weight1) * pmf_mix2

sum(pmf_geom*x)
sum(pmf_geom2*x)
sum(pmf_geom3*x)
sum(pmf_uniform*x)
sum(pmf_mixture*x)

# Combine into one data frame
data <- data.frame(
  x = x,
  Geometric = pmf_geom,
  Sum2Geometric = pmf_geom2,
  Sum3Geometric = pmf_geom3,
  Uniform = pmf_uniform,
  Mixture = pmf_mixture
)

# Reshape for ggplot
data_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
  data,
  cols = -x,
  names_to = "Distribution",
  values_to = "Probability"
)

# Color palette
color_palette <- c(
  "Geometric" = "#56B4E9",
  "Sum2Geometric" = "#F0E442",
  "Sum3Geometric" = "#E69F00",
  "Uniform" = "#009E73",
  "Mixture" = "#CC79A7"
)

# Plot
fig_100 <- ggplot(data_long, aes(x = x, y = log(Probability), color = Distribution)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = color_palette,
    breaks = c("Geometric", "Sum2Geometric", "Sum3Geometric", "Uniform", "Mixture"),
    labels = c("Geometric (mean: 100 bp)", "Sum of two geometric (mean: 100 bp)", "Sum of three geometric (mean: 100 bp)", "Uniform (mean: 100 bp)", "Mixture (mean: 100 bp)")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(1, 2000),
    breaks = c(1, seq(250, 2000, by = 250))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Tract length (bp)", y = "log(P(N = n))") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

# Save plot
ggsave("figs/pmf_100.png", width = 7, height = 5)
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
# Supplementary Figure

# Define PMF functions
calc_pmf_geom <- function(n, phi) {(1 - phi)^(n - 1) * phi}
calc_pmf_geom2 <- function(n, phi) {(n - 1) * (1 - phi)^(n - 2) * phi^2}
calc_pmf_geom3 <- function(n, phi) {choose(n - 1, 2) * (1 - phi)^(n - 3) * phi^3}

# Define support
x <- 1:750

# Compute PMFs
pmf_geom     <- sapply(x, calc_pmf_geom, phi = 1 / 21)
pmf_geom2    <- sapply(x, calc_pmf_geom2, phi = 2 / 21)
pmf_geom3    <- sapply(x, calc_pmf_geom3, phi = 3 / 21)
pmf_uniform  <- ifelse(x >= 1 & x <= 41, 1 / 41, 0)

# Mixture parameters
weight1 <- 0.005
mean1 <- 725
mean2 <- (21 - weight1 * mean1) / (1 - weight1)  # = 1300 / 19
phi1 <- 1 / mean1
phi2 <- 1 / mean2

# Compute mixture using calc_pmf_geom
pmf_mix1 <- sapply(x, calc_pmf_geom, phi = phi1)
pmf_mix2 <- sapply(x, calc_pmf_geom, phi = phi2)
pmf_mixture <- weight1 * pmf_mix1 + (1 - weight1) * pmf_mix2

sum(pmf_geom*x)
sum(pmf_geom2*x)
sum(pmf_geom3*x)
sum(pmf_uniform*x)
sum(pmf_mixture*x)

# Combine into one data frame
data <- data.frame(
  x = x,
  Geometric = pmf_geom,
  Sum2Geometric = pmf_geom2,
  Sum3Geometric = pmf_geom3,
  Uniform = pmf_uniform,
  Mixture = pmf_mixture
)

# Reshape for ggplot
data_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
  data,
  cols = -x,
  names_to = "Distribution",
  values_to = "Probability"
)

# Color palette
color_palette <- c(
  "Geometric" = "#56B4E9",
  "Sum2Geometric" = "#F0E442",
  "Sum3Geometric" = "#E69F00",
  "Uniform" = "#009E73",
  "Mixture" = "#CC79A7"
)

# Plot
fig_21 <- ggplot(data_long, aes(x = x, y = log(Probability), color = Distribution)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = color_palette,
    breaks = c("Geometric", "Sum2Geometric", "Sum3Geometric", "Uniform", "Mixture"),
    labels = c("Geometric (mean: 21 bp)", "Sum of two geometric (mean: 21 bp)", "Sum of three geometric (mean: 21 bp)", "Uniform (mean: 21 bp)", "Mixture (mean: 21 bp)")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(1, 750),
    breaks = c(1, seq(250, 750, by = 250))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Tract length (bp)", y = "log(P(N = n))") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

# Save plot
ggsave("figs/pmf_21.png", width = 7, height = 5)
```
